quests.title: Seven a.m. At the Ashfield Aquatic Centre
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. The site at the Ashfield Aquatic Centre starts its jackhammer at eight at night on a Monday, which is illegal and loud. You can tell me I am imagining it. Tell me after. Photograph it running and have a word with the Ashfield foreman. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: photograph the noise from the Ashfield Aquatic Centre
and have a word with the foreman

quests.title: Trolley Run, Hercules Street
quests.blurb: Right. Since you asked. A Woolies trolley from Hercules Street gets walked to the creek every Sunday. This is the third time I have had this conversation. Find where it ends up in Ashfield and make the deposit back. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: find the trolley near Hercules Street
photograph where it ended up
and earn the deposit back

quests.title: Before They Touch Hercules Street
quests.blurb: It is not a police matter and I have checked. They start on Hercules Street on Melbourne Cup day and the orange fencing goes up. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. I want Ashfield on record before it does. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: photograph the state of Hercules Street
then the other end of it

quests.title: Race Four, the Ashfield Bowlo
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. There's a horse in race four at eight at night that a bloke at the Ashfield Bowlo swears by. I have rung the number on the letter four times. Turn it into fifty-five somewhere in Ashfield and tell me if it came in. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: turn the tip into fifty-five
tell me if it came in

quests.title: Rent Money, the Ashfield Bowlo
quests.blurb: You will think I am making this up. I'm forty-five short on the the Ashfield Bowlo rent and the agent doesn't take stories. It started small, the way these things do. Make it somewhere in Ashfield by peak hour; I'm not fussy how. That's it. That's the whole ask.

steps.label: earn forty-five somewhere in Ashfield

quests.title: The Elizabeth Street Fence
quests.blurb: Before you say anything: yes, I know. My neighbour at Elizabeth Street says the tree is on my side and the fence says otherwise. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Look at it Easter Saturday with Ashfield eyes and tell me the truth. Half now if you want it. Most people don't.

steps.label: go and look at the fence at Elizabeth Street
photograph the tree over it
tell me whose side it's on

quests.title: The Length of Ashfield Mall
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. I haven't walked Ashfield Mall end to end since the light rail came to Ashfield. I have got no proof, which is exactly why I am asking. Do it the last Sunday of the month for me and photograph what's at the far end now. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: walk the length of Ashfield Mall
to the far end
photograph what's there now

quests.title: Trouble at Liverpool Road
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. Two lads and their mate decided at first thing that Liverpool Road is theirs. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. The rest of Ashfield disagrees, so explain the disagreement. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: sort the pair near Liverpool Road
and the mate who joined in

quests.title: One Stop From the Shanghai dumpling strip
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. I need to know the train from Ashfield stops at Burwood and doesn't sail through like it did on Anzac Day. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. Ride it at closing and photograph the sign. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: take the train to Burwood
and photograph the platform sign

quests.title: The the Shanghai dumpling strip Camera
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. A new speed camera near the Shanghai dumpling strip has fined half of Ashfield since the last Sunday of the month. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. Photograph it for the appeal, then prove the train to Burwood is faster anyway. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: photograph the camera near the Shanghai dumpling strip
then take the train instead, to Burwood

quests.title: Proof of the Shanghai dumpling strip
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. Nobody in Ashfield believes what the Shanghai dumpling strip looks like at dawn. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Get me a photo close enough that council can't say it's somewhere else. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: get a picture of the Shanghai dumpling strip before they fix it

quests.title: Staffy Near the Ashfield Aquatic Centre
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. A brindle staffy in a red bandana went over the fence at the Ashfield Aquatic Centre at closing. I am aware how that sounds. Everyone in Ashfield has definitely seen it and can't say where. Take your time. Do not take a week.

steps.label: check the off-leash bit near the Ashfield Aquatic Centre
photograph the creek end
tell me if you saw a staffy in a bandana

quests.title: Something From the Ashfield Aquatic Centre
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. The stall at the Ashfield Aquatic Centre has run out and the customers keep coming. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. Find something round Ashfield that'll do before the lunchtime rush. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: pick something up near the Ashfield Aquatic Centre
bring it to the stall

quests.title: The Hercules Street Float
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. The till at Hercules Street opens Wednesday with an empty float because somebody took it to the pub. You can tell me I am imagining it. Tell me after. Sixty before the first Ashfield customer, and I'll never say who. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: clear sixty for the Hercules Street float
hand it over at the counter

quests.title: The the Ashfield Bowlo Order
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. The the Ashfield Bowlo order came to seventy more than I'd budgeted and the supplier wants it by midnight. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. Find seventy in Ashfield and photograph the receipt. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: square the seventy for the the Ashfield Bowlo order
then photograph the receipt on the counter
